'''Umax''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], on which a [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] had been established. [[Sonko Fromm]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Annoo-dat Blue]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was briefly [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] on Umax before he was freed by his boss [[Sise Fromm]].<ref name="tdr-a">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
